subject: keycap-cluster
notes: GMK CYL TA Neo is a keycap-set group buy (productKind: keycap-set) — six CYL-profile keycaps in two staggered rows of three, matching the shared cap template/grid from kbdfans-gmk-cyl-ramune.svg. Two caps (back-middle, front-right) carry a cool dark slate-blue-grey fill for the 'returning classic' alpha character; one focal cap (front-middle) carries a vivid neon-cyan splash plus a small hollow terminal-cursor rect motif on its dish, a quiet nod to TA's retro-terminal lineage. Remaining three caps are warm-grey stroke only. Palette chosen to honor heroImageAlt ('cool slate-and-neon TA Neo colorway') and to read distinctly from the warm-bronze/terracotta novelkeys-gmk-cyl-og-extensions.svg sibling per the brief. The neon-cyan value (oklch 0.74 0.12 195) was numerically verified in-gamut for sRGB (max in-gamut chroma at L0.74/H195 is ~0.123, computed via manual OKLab->linear-sRGB conversion) before use, since 'neon' hues at high lightness clip easily. Bronze theme dot (oklch 0.80 0.135 75) retained as the fixed family ornamental anchor per novelkeys-gmk-cyl-og-extensions.svg and divinikey-dcs-dolch.svg precedent, independent of this record's own splash palette. Two-tone slate+neon treatment mirrors the established multi-hue exception already used in kbdfans-gmk-cyl-ramune.svg for a similarly two-tone colorway kit.
